# THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST IN DOMINO’S SMART SLICE


If you are a student, parent, teacher or school administrator, **please contact your district food service director** to discuss the Domino’s Pizza Smart Slice program advantages for your schools.


# INTERESTED IN SERVING DOMINO’S SMART SLICE IN YOUR SCHOOLS?


If you are a food service professional and would like more information, please fill out the form below and we will contact you.


**General inquiries** - please contactschoollunchinfo@dominos.com .


**Media questions** - please contactjenny.fouracre@dominos.com .
